import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int DEBUG = 0;
    static final int MAX_VAL = 999999999;
    static final long MAX_VAL_2 = 999999999999999999L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-6;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int inv(int n) {
        int e = MOD - 2;
        long r = 1;
        long base = n;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) != 0) r = (r * base) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
        }
        return (int) r;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[][] P = new int[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                P[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
            }
        }

        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> masks2 = new ArrayList<>();

        int h = (n + 1) / 2;
        int h2 = n - h;
        int inv100 = inv(100);
        int size = 1 << n;

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(i);
            if (c == h) masks.add(i);
            if (c == h2) masks2.add(i);
        }

        int maxMaskSize = masks.size();
        int maxMaskSize2 = masks2.size();

        int totalStatesH = 1 << n * h;
        int totalStatesH2 = 1 << n * h2;

        // Probabilities for each configuration
        long[] prob = new long[1 << maxMaskSize];
        long[] prob2 = new long[1 << maxMaskSize2];

        // Compute for first half
        for (int i = 0; i < totalStatesH; i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n * h; j++) {
                int x = j / n, y = j % n;
                if (((i >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                    p = (p * ((long) P[x][y] * inv100)) % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = (p * ((long) (100 - P[x][y]) * inv100 % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }

            int poss = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < maxMaskSize; j++) {
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                int maskJ = masks.get(j);
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((maskJ >> k) & 1) != 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k * n + v.get(k);
                        if (((i >> a) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        poss |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob[poss] = (prob[poss] + p) % MOD;
        }

        // Compute for second half
        for (int i = 0; i < totalStatesH2; i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n * h2; j++) {
                int x = j / n + h, y = j % n;
                if (((i >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                    p = (p * ((long) P[x][y] * inv100)) % MOD;
                } else {
                    p = (p * ((long) (100 - P[x][y]) * inv100 % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }

            int poss = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < maxMaskSize; j++) {
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                int maskJ = masks.get(j);
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((maskJ >> k) & 1) == 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k * n + v.get(k);
                        if (((i >> a) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        poss |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob2[poss] = (prob2[poss] + p) % MOD;
        }

        // Sum over subsets for prob2
        for (int i = 0; i < maxMaskSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << maxMaskSize); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    prob2[j] = (prob2[j] + prob2[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        long fullMask = (1L << maxMaskSize) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << maxMaskSize); i++) {
            long temp = ( (long) prob[i] * prob2[(int)((fullMask) ^ i)] ) % MOD;
            ans += temp;
            ans %= MOD;
        }

        long result = ((MOD + 1 - ans) % MOD);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> data) {
        int i = data.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && data.get(i) >= data.get(i + 1))
            i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = data.size() - 1;
        while (data.get(j) <= data.get(i))
            j--;
        Collections.swap(data, i, j);
        for (int a = i + 1, b = data.size() - 1; a < b; a++, b--) {
            Collections.swap(data, a, b);
        }
        return true;
    }
}
